podcast.title: Collaborator and Producer for Royce Immorce
podcast.body: Matthew Gerber is an influential artist, producer, and graphic designer who played a crucial role as a collaborator and producer for Royce Immorce's solo debut album, "El Rabidud." He maintained a strong working relationship with Royce Immorce, having previously contributed remixes for Demoloco, collaborated with the band, and attended various festivals and concerts alongside them. "Matthew Gerber que aparte de ser un artista es importantísimo, productor mientras música gráfica y ya tenía una buena relación con Royce and Boercy."

podcast.title: Industry Reputation
podcast.body: Within the music industry, Matthew Gerber is highly regarded for his pleasant demeanor and professional qualities. He is known for his "easy-going temperament," being "pleasant," "easy to work with," and possessing a "good character." These specific attributes were precisely what Royce Immorce sought and needed during the challenging period of recording her solo album. "Matthew Gerber para el que no lo sepa dentro de esta industria tiene una fama bastante buena, tiene jamás un teof fácil, les anteo a nadable, les anteo a cualquier espacin trabajar y tener muy muercalácter, con lo cual para ella era precisamente lo que necesitaba."
